property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer makes external calls to the callee for every element in _tos in increasing index order starting at 0; the mutant skips index 0 and thus does not call the callee for the first element, which the test detects by recording per-call arguments.
change_summary: Invert the loop condition to start from 1 and iterate while i<=_tos.length-1, changing the order of calls and thus observable behavior when multiple _tos are provided.
